nodes.nie.text.t: "Pity. Let hunger remind him he's got a wife."

nodes.s.text.t: A baker stands in the street with a basket of loaves that hides half her face. "Luiza, baker. The gravedigger at the Common Graveyard never has time to come for bread, he's got too much work. Will you take it to him? I won't go, I've got a bitter history with graveyards. He'll pay you, and if he doesn't, at least you'll know where to bury him."

nodes.zgoda.text.t: Luiza tucks a loaf inside your jacket and brushes the flour off your sleeve. "Go, while it's warm. Cold bread isn't the same, just like a cold gravedigger."
